sloka: ततो रामो महातेजा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्।प्रविश्य राक्षसं सैन्यं शरवर्षं ववर्ष ह ।। ६.९४.१८ ।।
transliteration: tato rāmo mahātejā dhanurādāya vīryavān।praviśya rākṣasaṁ sainyaṁ śaravarṣaṁ vavarṣa ha ।। 6.94.18 ।।

translations.english: Then, the highly energetic and valiant Rama, taking up the bow showered rain of arrows on Rakshasa army.
